patch_description:
This constructor combines two complementary packing ideas: a dense square/interstice seed and staggered hexagonal-layer seeds. Rather than relying only on independent multistart SLSQP runs, it uses a contact-graph continuation strategy: each nonlinear candidate is first certified and improved with an exact fixed-center radius LP, then several carefully scaled deterministic center perturbations are restarted from the best LP-derived radius pattern.

The nonlinear stage uses squared-distance contact constraints with an analytic Jacobian, making repeated continuation solves substantially cheaper than finite-difference optimization. The final LP gives the best nonuniform radii for the selected centers, while a final common contraction guarantees strict containment and non-overlap.
